rows.resolution_note: The Study Population and Proteomic Data Sources sentences describe the UKB-PPP project as a whole (54,219 participants in three subcohorts, 2,923 proteins, reference 16 with several dictionary rows); 54,219 is no row's sample size and no sentence says which pQTL GWAS (discovery, replication or combined) supplied the summary data, so the description is of the cohort and not of one release.
